author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I apply Schluter ALL-SET to the KERDI-DRAIN with a 6-inch joint compound knife. Then I use the KERDI-TROWEL to comb the mortar and embed the KERDI-COLLAR. The connection to the drain and tray is waterproof because the thin-set crystal matrix between the fleece layers is tight and water molecules are too big to pass through
title: Schluter KERDI-DRAIN Waterproofing Tips - #shorts #showerremodel #schlutersystems #brandpartner
